mapper.sql: SELECT K.KWRD_DICT_SN , K.DICT_USG_CD , K.KWRD_CLSF_NM , K.ARTCL_NM , K.KWRD_CN , K.INTRP_RSLT_CN , K.MPNG_CD , C.COM_CD_NM AS MPNG_CD_NM , K.SORT_SEQ , K.RMRK_CN , K.USE_YN FROM KWRD_DICT K LEFT JOIN COM_CD C ON C.COM_CD = K.MPNG_CD AND C.COM_CD_PRNT_SN IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: /* 키워드 등록 */ INSERT INTO KWRD_DICT (DICT_USG_CD, KWRD_CLSF_NM, ARTCL_NM, KWRD_CN, INTRP_RSLT_CN, MPNG_CD, SORT_SEQ, RMRK_CN, USE_YN, RGTR_ID, MDFR_ID) VALUES (#{keyword.dictUsgCd}, #{keyword.kwrdClsfNm}, #{keyword.artclNm}, #{keyword.kwrdCn}, #{keyword.intrpRsltCn}, #{keyword.mpngCd}, #{keyword.sortSeq}, #{keyword.rmrkCn}, #{keyword.useYn}, #{actorId}, #{actorId})
